summary_en: This study tests the study drug [212Pb]VMT-Alpha-NET in people with metastatic or inoperable tumors that have somatostatin receptors, including gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors, pheochromocytoma/paragangliomas, small cell lung cancer, kidney cancer, and head and neck cancers. The drug is given through a vein (IV) on Day 1 of each of 4 eight-week cycles, with doses escalated in Phase I and set at the maximum tolerated dose in dose expansion. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase I study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba el medicamento [212Pb]VMT-Alpha-NET en personas con tumores metastásicos o no operables que tienen receptores de somatostatina, incluidos tumores neuroendocrinos gastrointestinales, feocromocitomas/paragangliomas, cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas, cáncer de riñón y cáncer de cabeza y cuello. Se administra por vena (IV) el día 1 de cada uno de 4 ciclos de 8 semanas, con dosis que aumentan por etapas en la fase I y se fijan en la dosis máxima tolerada en la expansión. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; es un estudio de fase I.
who_for: Metastatic or inoperable tumor of a listed type with somatostatin receptor expression on at least 50% of visible tumor.
Small cell lung cancer: at least one prior line of standard systemic treatment.
Kidney cancer: prior therapy requirements apply, including a PD1/PDL1 inhibitor and a VEGF-pathway agent for most renal cell cancers.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less, with adequate blood and organ function.
not_for: Prior systemic radioligand therapy given for definitive treatment.
Pregnancy, or a positive pregnancy test in people who can become pregnant.
QTc above 450 ms on EKG at screening.
Active or untreated secondary malignancy, except nonmelanoma skin cancer and cervical carcinoma in situ.
Allergic reaction to compounds similar to VMT-Alpha-NET.
